title: Settlement of a Retrofit Project the Owner Stops
content:
# Settlement of a Retrofit Project the Owner Stops

An owner who no longer wants a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects carried through may stop it, and the project is then settled at a figure covering the stage it had reached and what it has already cost. This page states the entry to that settlement and how the stop is recorded.

## What the settlement does

Recording the stop marks the project stopped as of that day, records the stage it had reached and the reason the owner gives, raises a cancellation line on the project for the figure it is settled at, and adds that figure to what is owed on the project. Afterwards the project is closed to further work and the owner sees the cancellation line and the settlement on the project statement.

The settlement figure on a stopped project is worked out only once every week the delivered equipment has stood in storage is carried as a storage charge on the project's billing record.

## Recording the stop

Stopping the project is the owner's own act. The tool `settle_project_cancellation_6d1f2e6f` is a hidden tool belonging to the customer: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it. One call stops and settles one project.

### Parameters

- `project_id` — the reference number of the replacement or retrofit project being stopped, as it stands in the project lookup for this owner.
- `settlement_amount_usd` — the money figure the project is settled at, in USD, given as a decimal number rounded half to even to 2 decimal places; it is stored to that same precision and may not be left empty.
- `cancellation_reason` — why the owner is stopping the project, one of: `customer_convenience`, where the owner simply no longer wants the work done and gives no other ground; `non_payment`, where the company stops the project because invoices on it have gone unpaid; `estimate_lapsed`, where the estimate ran out before it was awarded and is closed instead of repriced; `budget_withdrawn`, where the money for the work has been taken away from the owner's capital plan; `scope_replaced`, where the same scope is being carried by another project instead; `site_sold_or_closed`, where the building has been sold or shut and the work can no longer be done there.

### Return

A confirmation sentence in plain text carrying the project reference, the stage the project had reached when it was stopped, the reason recorded, the reference of the settlement record entry created on the project, the settlement figure in USD to two decimal places and the project balance after it. The owner can see the same stopped status and the same settlement line on the project statement.
